item.title: Amanda Jill Robinson to Take Over for Zoë Roberts in OPERATION MINCEMEAT
item.description: Amanda Jill Robinson will take over for Zoë Roberts as Johnny Bevan & Others in Operation Mincemeat on Broadway. Original cast members David Cumming, Claire-Marie Hall, Natasha Hodgson, Jak Malone, and Zoë Roberts will perform through February 22nd 2026. item.title: Broadway's STRANGER THINGS: THE FIRST SHADOW to Be Filmed for Netflix Release
item.description: Hawkins is returning to your living rooms. According to Collider, Broadway's Stranger Things: The First Shadow, the prequel play to the Netflix hit, will be filmed this week for a future release on the streamer. Performances from Tuesday, February 10 to Saturday, February 14 will go dark to accommodate. item.description: The Broadway production of Schmigadoon! will reveal its cast tomorrow. item.title: Video: Jack Wolfe Performs 'EPIC I' From HADESTOWN at Prophecy Hall
item.description: Jack Wolfe has released his rendition of "Epic I" from Hadestown by Anaïs Mitchell. The stripped-back performance was recorded live at Prophecy Hall in Beacon, NY and the video is by Michael Rees and Sarah Penson. Wolfe will take his final bow as ‘Orpheus' in the Broadway production on Sunday, March 1. item.title: Jay Copeland, Nikki Renée Daniels, Jason Gotay And Jill Paice To Lead York Theatre SONGS FOR A NEW WORLD Spring Benefit
item.description: The York Theatre Company will present its Spring Benefit 2026 with a staged performance of Songs for a New World, the song cycle by composer and lyricist Jason Robert Brown, directed by Jessica McRoberts. The one-night-only event will feature performances by Jay Copeland, Nikki Renée Daniels, Jason Gotay, and Jill Paice, and will take place at the Theatre at St. Jean’s, home of The York Theatre. item.title: Alex Brightman, Erika Henningsen, Joel Perez and More Lead THE PRINCESS BRIDE Workshop
item.description: A workshop of the highly-anticipated stage musical adaptation of The Princess Bride recently took place featuring an impressive cast stacked with Broadway luminaries. According to a post from cast member Marissa Rosen, the workshop was led by a cast headed by Tony-nominee Alex Brightman as Billy, Jonathan Hadary as Grampa, Kevin William Paul as Westley, and Erika Henningsen as Princess Buttercup. item.title: OH, MARY!, KINKY BOOTS and More Set For Theatre Under The Stars 2026/27 Season
item.description: Theatre Under The Stars has unveiled a lineup of Broadway hits for its 2026/27 season. The upcoming season features everything from beloved classics to the acclaimed comedy, Oh, Mary! The 2026/27 season at the Hobby Center opens in September with the beloved classic Meredith Willson’s The Music Man.
